trust_decision.summary: Untrusted spreadsheet input decides how much memory/work a reader spends: Gnumeric gzip output size is uncapped (gzdecode with no max length) and OLE sector chains are followed with no cycle detection (OLERead walks while block != -2).

landing_point.why: The summary names Gnumeric gzip expansion; the only gzdecode call in src is here, inside gzfileGetContents.

fix_sites.entry_point: Gnumeric::canRead / listWorksheetNames / listWorksheetInfo / load(loadIntoExisting) via gzfileGetContents (Gnumeric.php:84,113,144,261); also IOFactory::load/identify
new Gnumeric(): constructor derives the cap from memory_limit; new public setMaxLength() (fix.diff:28-42)
Xls::canRead (XlsBase.php:161-164) and Xls::load/listWorksheetNames/listWorksheetInfo (Xls.php:379-387) via OLERead::read small-block-depot chain
fix_sites.module_kind: shared low-level container parser (looks out of scope for a Gnumeric advisory)

fix_sites.entry_point: Xls load paths via OLERead::getStream, small-stream chain
Xls load paths via OLERead::getStream, big-stream chain
OLERead::read directory stream and getStream root data via readData

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/PhpSpreadsheet/Shared/OLERead.php:140-222 (cycle detection on OLE block chains, reached from the Xls reader; the advisory title is about Gnumeric gzip only)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about Gnumeric gzip expansion; an Xls/OLE sector-chain loop is a different format, a different mechanism (infinite loop rather than decompression) and a different file, so a solver would call it unrelated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate files must keep loading. Uncompressed Gnumeric files and normal gzip ones must stay readable, the cap must follow memory_limit (-1 maps to 128M) and be adjustable through setMaxLength. For OLE, each chain needs its own visited set: small-block and big-block numbers live in different index spaces, and getStream calls readData(root) before walking the small chain, so a visited set shared across chains or not reset would reject valid .xls files.

O6_input_shapes: OLE directory/root chain loop via readData

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Second OLE implementation: the Shared\OLE public read() plus the ChainedBlockStream stream wrapper follows bbat/sbat chains with no cycle detection.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Shared\OLE comes from the PEAR writer port and no reader calls OLE::read (Reader/Xls only uses its static date helpers), so it looks like writer-side legacy code.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another file and sub-namespace (Shared/OLE/) from OLERead; 3 files from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Shared\OLE::read reads the MBAT chain for an attacker-chosen mbbatBlockCount, and getStream(sbatFirstBlockId) walks the SBAT chain unbounded.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Public lower-level API that no shipped reader uses.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Unbounded decompression of zip members in the Xlsx reader: getFromName is called with length 0, meaning no limit.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A different format (zip, not gzip), handled by ext/zip; the advisory names only Gnumeric.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Unbounded decompression in the Ods reader: content.xml is streamed through zip:// into XMLReader with no size cap.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Streams through XMLReader rather than loading into one string; a different format.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second gzip helper (for example a gzopen/compress.zlib:// streaming fallback when gzdecode is missing) with no length cap
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The existing code already branches on function_exists('gzdecode'), so a maintainer could plausibly add a fallback branch there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An extension-block (MSAT) chain that follows next-block pointers read from the file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already follows extensionBlock pointers from file data; a while-based variant is a natural rewrite.

O9_family: uncontrolled resource consumption (decompression bomb CWE-409 / infinite loop on cyclic OLE sector chain CWE-400/835)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x + composer + PHPUnit; ext-zlib, ext-xmlreader, ext-zip
O10_build.project_tests: tests/PhpSpreadsheetTests/Reader/Gnumeric/, tests/PhpSpreadsheetTests/Reader/Xls/ (fix adds LargeDecompressionTest.php and OleLoopTest.php plus binary fixtures)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Pass a fixed max length to gzdecode in Gnumeric::gzfileGetContents and stop, never touching the OLE chain walkers.

out_of_scope_notes: Shared/OLE.php:349 readPpsWks walks the directory tree with a while(!empty($nos)) worklist; a cyclic directory may loop (same class as the O8 route, not pursued).
OLERead.php:113-126 and OLE.php:165 loop counts come straight from header fields (attacker-chosen iteration counts), which is a bounded-but-large work issue rather than a cycle.
unverified: Whether Shared\OLE::read is reachable from any shipped reader: grep found no reader call to ->read() on an OLE instance; it is only reachable as a public API.
Whether the Xlsx/Ods zip-bomb routes fall within this advisory's property or were covered by the sibling advisories (c_sibling_advisories=3) was not checked.
present_in_latest is unknown for all O8 routes (no latest release provided).
Strongest negative: the family is resource exhaustion, which per lessons-v2 has produced 0 of 7 hard tasks; this is not one of the enum red flags, so it is recorded here.
